name: Johnny Rockets
description: The most popular and beloved dining destination at Six Flags Great Adventure — Johnny Rockets is a classic American diner serving legendary burgers, crispy fries, thick milkshakes and classic American comfort food in a fun 1950s-themed atmosphere. One of the most enjoyable and rerideable dining experiences at any Six Flags park in the world.

name: Fatburger
description: A beloved and legendary California burger chain at Six Flags Great Adventure serving the famous Fatburger — a thick, juicy and customisable beef burger made to order with fresh ingredients. One of the most popular and satisfying burger experiences at any New Jersey theme park.
